SEIR Core Simulation (No Lesion Expansion)

Source: R/seir.R
dot-seir_core_no_lex.Rd

Internal workhorse for SEIR model without lesion expansion. Implements the standard Susceptible-Exposed-Infectious-Removed compartmental model using efficient cumulative sum techniques to avoid O(n²) nested loops.

Usage

.seir_core_no_lex(
  duration,
  onset_idx,
  H0,
  Iprim,
  Rc,
  p_days,
  i_days,
  RRG_vals,
  RRS_vals,
  a_vals,
  Sx
)

Arguments

duration

Simulation duration (integer days).

onset_idx

1-indexed day of primary inoculum injection (integer).

H0

Initial healthy sites (integer).

Iprim

Vector of primary inoculum injection on each day (numeric).

Rc

Daily infection rate (numeric vector, length = duration).

p_days

Daily latent period (numeric vector, length = duration).

i_days

Daily infectious period (numeric vector, length = duration).

RRG_vals

Daily relative growth rate (numeric vector).

RRS_vals

Daily relative senescence rate (numeric vector).

a_vals

Daily aggregation coefficient (numeric vector, ≥ 1).

Sx

Maximum site capacity (integer).

Value

A data.table::data.table() with columns:

  • sites, latent, infectious, removed, senesced: state vars

  • rateinf, rlex, rtransfer, rremoved, rgrowth, rsenesced: flow rates

  • diseased, intensity: derived

Details

rlex is always 0 in this variant (no lesion expansion).

Cumulative Sum Optimization: Instead of summing over a sliding window (latent/infectious durations), this implementation maintains cs_lat and cs_inf (cumulative sums of latency inflows and infectious inflows). The count of sites currently infectious is: cs_inf[t] - cs_inf[t - i_days[t] - 2], avoiding O(n) inner loops.

Algorithm

Computes daily transitions using lagged cumulative sums to efficiently extract windowed counts (infectious periods are handled via integer delays into history arrays). Day 1 initializes pools; main loop (days 2+) updates compartments based on infection rate, latency exit, and recovery.
